meta.title: Memory anchor
meta.description: Records only the decisions, rejections and root causes that code cannot describe, each with a verify step, and reports where the memory still failed to help.

embeddingDesc: When enabled, writing a memory calls the selected service to produce a semantic vector, so retrieval understands paraphrases and other languages. When off, a local character-hash vector is used: no dependencies and works offline, but it matches surface form only.
embeddingDimensionsHint: 1024 and 2048 retrieve about equally well in testing; 1024 stores less.
embeddingReindexNote: After switching models, existing memories still hold vectors from the old one. Run the memory tool with action=reindex to recompute them; until then, cross-model entries are down-weighted rather than dropped.
embeddingSavedMemoryOnly: Applied, but the config file was not written (reverts on restart)
